title: Deprecation Policies
description: Writes the rules for retiring versions - notice periods, support windows, exception processes - before any deprecation begins. Policy turns retirement from ad-hoc breakage into a predictable contract with users.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Sunset Timelines
description: Publishes explicit dates - deprecation warning, feature freeze, shutdown - so every consumer can plan. Timelines with real dates beat vague 'eventually' every time.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Usage Telemetry
description: Measures who still uses the deprecated version so shutdown decisions rest on data, not guesses. Telemetry reveals the long tail of stragglers that always exists and must be handled deliberately.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Migration Guides
description: Documents the path from old to new - changed APIs, behavior differences, step-by-step examples - so migration is work, not archaeology. Great guides are the kindest thing a deprecating team can ship.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Warning Injection
description: Emits deprecation warnings in logs, headers, and responses when the old version is used, reaching developers where they work. Warnings must be actionable - naming the replacement and the deadline.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Compatibility Windows
description: Guarantees the old and new versions interoperate during a defined window, so mixed deployments work while migration proceeds. Windows prevent the flag-day upgrades that cause outages.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: API Versioning
description: Versions APIs explicitly - in paths, headers, or content negotiation - so old clients keep working while new ones advance. Versioning is what makes deprecation a choice rather than a breaking change.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Feature Flags
description: Gates the new behavior behind flags so migration happens per-user or per-tenant without version forks. Flags let deprecation proceed gradually, with instant rollback if the new path misbehaves.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Stakeholder Notices
description: Notifies every stakeholder class - developers, operators, executives, customers - through their own channels with relevant detail. Notices prevent the 'nobody told us' failures that sink deprecations.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Code Removal
description: Deletes the deprecated code paths after the sunset date, with the removal itself reviewed and tested. Removal is the payoff: less code, fewer bugs, faster builds.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Dependency Updates
description: Updates downstream dependencies off the deprecated version, tracked as a work queue until empty. The deprecation is not done when the code ships - it is done when the last dependent migrates.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Documentation
description: Updates all documentation - guides, references, examples - to the new version, archiving the old docs with clear 'deprecated' banners. Docs are where most users meet the deprecation, so they must lead, not lag.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Rollback
description: Keeps the ability to restore the old version quickly if the new one fails in production, until confidence is complete. Rollback plans make deprecation bold instead of scary.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Compliance
description: Verifies the deprecation meets regulatory and contractual obligations - data retention, notice periods, accessibility of archives. Compliance review prevents legal surprises after the shutdown.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Post-Sunset Verification
description: Confirms after the sunset date that the old version is truly gone - no traffic, no references, no zombie processes. Verification closes the loop: the deprecation is done when the checks say so.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
